summary: Get-BundledPlugins read the whole index as one entry
description:
Landed in:
- DevHub `4092ca1`: Fix Get-BundledPlugins: unroll the index (Invoke-RestMethod hands a JSON array over as one object, so a plugin's entry was the whole list and the release failed on its apiVersion); checked against the real index (the four 1.0.0 plugins) and in a Release build that loads them
